presets.name: baseline-illustrative
presets.description: The line with the highlighted word notice is inspected; the word becomes notification and, in exact mode, the highlight, tab and thread of that passage retract.

presets.name: contrast-or-alternative
presets.description: Substantive alternative: the substituted datum is the query term (notice → notified); passages that contained notice lose their links and the passage that contains notified gains one.
